core.title: 2 Inch Diamond Swing Cabinet Pull, Acorn IPABP

text.description_html:
Acorn IPABP, 2" Diamond Mount Ring Pull

Great for armoires, closets, cabinets, dressers and more, the 2" Diamond Swing Cabinet Pull made by Acorn is versatile and beautiful. Appearing as if it came straight from antiquity, the black iron finish mimics the look of naturally weathered iron. It is forged in the traditional way, using a hammer and anvil. The Diamond Mount Ring Pull has a rustic look perfect for period or traditional homes.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Diamond Ring Pull:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Height: 2"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
